fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/web -run 'TestLayoutGolden|TestHeaderNoProjectList' passes with the goldens regenerated from the new header: the picker button carries the needs-you count and points at /picker, the nav names Home, Runs and Roadmap with aria-current on the current page, and a two-project root's page names no project but the current one anywhere in its body (failure case: a project with nothing waiting shows no count badge).
fields.statement: Every web page shares one header as in pages/frame-and-spacing.html and pages/home.html: the Rhiza wordmark, the project picker button with the current project's needs-you count (the count web-picker-menu defines, read from that project alone), the Home, Runs and Roadmap nav, the daemon pill and the live indicator; 56px tall on a phone with the nav on its own 44px row, 52px on desktop; no list of project names in the header or anywhere in the page's markup, the picker's list being loaded from /picker when the button opens it.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/web -run 'TestProjectPicker|TestSwitcherNamesReadOnlyForPages' passes: TestProjectPicker GETs /picker for a page of a two-project root and finds both listed with live state and needs-you counts, the one with items first, each link keeping the page kind (from /p/a/roadmap, b links to /p/b/roadmap), All projects linking to the merged inbox, and the search field present only with six or more projects; TestSwitcherNamesReadOnlyForPages, rewritten, fails if an asset, a fragment or a page render under /p/<project>/ calls the ProjectsSource, and if one GET /picker does not call it exactly once.
fields.statement: The header's project button opens a picker (a bottom sheet on a phone, a menu on desktop, as in pages/project-picker.html) listing every registered project with whether it is live and its needs-you count, projects with something waiting first, plus an All projects entry for the merged inbox; switching keeps the same kind of page, and a search field appears once there are more than five projects. The list is not in the page: the root serves it at /picker, given the current page's path, and reads the ProjectsSource only for that request, so assets, fragments and page renders still never read it. A project's live state is Running plus Waiting above zero, and its needs-you count is a new ProjectView field holding the same count Home's 'things need you' title shows: open questions, sign-offs, failed runs, stuck runs and holds. The header's inline project-name switcher and its ProjectNames list are retired.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/web -run 'TestPartialsGolden|TestSpacingRules' passes: the goldens are regenerated, and TestSpacingRules parses static/css/rhiza.css and fails unless the page head's gap between kicker and title is var(--space-3) (12px), the panel head's gap between kicker and title is var(--space-1) (4px), the panel head's margin to the content is var(--space-4) (16px), the gap between panels is var(--space-5) (24px), the gap between page sections is var(--space-6) (32px), and panel padding is var(--space-4) (16px) by default and var(--space-5) (24px) inside the desktop media query; it also fails on any heading rule with a margin and any template with an inline margin style (failure case: a stylesheet with the panel gap at 16px fails).
fields.statement: Every web page follows the spacing rules in pages/frame-and-spacing.html: kicker to page title 12px, panel kicker to panel title 4px, panel title to content 16px, panels 24px apart, page sections 32px, panel padding 16px on a phone and 24px on desktop, gaps set on the parent and headings with no margin of their own.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/web -run TestTypeScale passes: it parses static/css/rhiza-tokens.css for the scale's tokens with exactly the sizes and line heights above, and fails on any font-size, line-height or font shorthand in static/css/rhiza.css or a template's inline style that does not use one of them (failure case: a 28px/32px section title fails).
fields.statement: Every web page sets its text from one type scale as in pages/frame-and-spacing.html and pages/project-picker.html, defined once as tokens in static/css/rhiza-tokens.css: page title 36/40, section title 28/34 and panel title 20/26 in the display face; lead 17, body 15/22, rows and tables 14/20, meta 13/18 and labels 12/16 in the body face; static/css/rhiza.css and the templates set no font size outside those tokens.
